results.content: # Trump expected to hold Myrtle Beach rally for U.S. Senate runoff. MYRTLE BEACH, SC (WMBF) - President Donald Trump is slated to come to the Grand Strand this week. results.content: President Donald Trump has finally given the green light to pour millions of dollars from his personal PAC toward boosting vulnerable Republicans in November, two people familiar with the plans told CNN, as some top campaign advisers privately acknowledge that Republicans’ chances of keeping control of both the House and Senate are dwindling. “There is a path where we keep the House and the Senate,” one source told CNN. Trump is also belatedly preparing to ratchet up his own campaigning schedule, with plans to travel at least once a week to hold a spate of rallies in battleground districts, one adviser said.
